purpose: Use trend direction and quality for aggregate equity risk budget, not asset-return ranking
additional_controls: Fixed 40% or neutral 35% equity proposals with the same 20% gold and the same forecast-volatility rule; added after first budget comparison to separate trend from volatility scaling
bond_rule: Remaining budget, equal within the same bond pool; single bond target cap 90%, remainder cash
constraint: Scale equity and gold down together if their full-portfolio past-covariance risk exceeds target; restore remainder to bonds
scale_solver: Largest feasible scale on 0..1 grid with 0.01 increments, using known covariance only; cash if none is feasible
rebalance_rule: Use the smaller of absolute equity band and relative target-amount band, including passive controls
risk_exit_rule: Bearish or volatility-limited reductions may redeem young lots and pay the full short fee
limitations: Forecast volatility is not a future risk guarantee
Targets can differ from actual exposure due to fees, price drift, execution delay and settlement
Previously viewed histories and surviving product selection
Full historic product fees and NAV publication/distribution dates remain scenario assumptions
